data.simple_definition: Return on equity measures profitability relative to shareholder equity.
data.detailed_explanation: ROE helps evaluate how efficiently a company uses shareholder capital.
data.why_it_matters: It helps compare profitability across peers.
data.practical_interpretation: Higher ROE can be positive, but it should be checked with debt levels.
data.limitations: ROE can be distorted by leverage and accounting effects.
data.example: A company earning INR 20 on INR 100 equity has 20% ROE.
data.disclaimer: This is educational content and not investment advice.
